description: Data, losses and metrics of milestone 6 (plan.md items 5-10): params constants (DEFORM_TASK, ALL_TASKS, N_TRAIN_LABELS=19, deform_residual_ranges), DALI DeformPipeline (two aligned numpy readers for image and labels_train18, optional residual affine with the same matrix: linear for images, nearest for labels, emitting T), data-module wiring (lazy label files, deform dataset), DeformPostprocess (shared flips for images and labels, one-hot, pair sampling), synthetic label phantoms + smooth SVF groups and DeformValidationSet in runtime/fixed_data.py, deformable losses (masked soft Dice template + pairwise via compose(u_i, u_inv_j), first/second-order smoothness), deformable numpy metrics. Depends on FEAT-001 (models/diffeo.py). P.TASKS stays linear.
steps: Read context.json, plan.md sections 0-1 and items 5-10, then data_loading/params.py, dali_loader.py, data_module.py, postprocess.py, runtime/fixed_data.py, runtime/losses.py, runtime/metrics.py, tests/runtime_helpers.py, and FEAT-001 findings. Read (do not modify) reference/2_deformable_groupwise_registration_src/runtime/losses.py DiceLoss and deformation_field_gradient_loss.

(uint8, DHWC, .gpu()); class DeformPipeline per plan.md item 5 (ValueError for 'buffer' mode and unequal lists, validated before require_dali where practical; residual off: no warp; residual on: build_linear_matrices(random_linear_params(P.deform_residual_ranges(level, **residual_ranges))), warp_linear for images, fn.warp_affine(labels, matrix=t_pull, inverse_map=True, fill_value=0, interp_type=INTERP_NN) for labels, outputs (images, labels, t_fwd.gpu()); intensity_augment on images only; output_signature()). Update the module docstring (deform outputs, alignment rationale).

data_loading/postprocess.py: DeformPostprocess(level, flip_prob=0.5, p_pdice=0.1, seed=0, n_classes=P.N_TRAIN_LABELS, residual_affine=False, pixel_center=P.DALI_PIXEL_CENTER) per plan.md item 7 (images and labels flipped with the same F, labels int32 [N,X,Y,Z], onehot float32, pair_i/pair_j via sample_pairs, T_render = F T F when the residual is on). Docstring.

runtime/fixed_data.py: synthetic_label_phantom, random_svf, synthetic_deform_group, to_deform_batch, load_level_images_and_labels, VAL_DEFORM_SEED = 404, DeformValidationSet (build, from_group, subset, task='deform') per plan.md item 8. Linear ValidationSet unchanged.

runtime/losses.py: soft_dice, template_dice_loss, pair_dice_loss, smoothness_loss(order 1 forward differences / order 2 bending energy), deform_loss per plan.md item 9 (masked mean over present foreground channels; template without stop_gradient; pairs through diffeo.compose(u_i, u_inv_j); fp32). Module docstring section for the deformable losses.
runtime/metrics.py: hard_dice_per_label, mean_fg_dice, deform_group_errors, deform_pair_dice_loss per plan.md item 10 (numpy float64, NaN-skip for absent labels). Docstring.

Tests: tests/test_data_loading.py (signature, output_count, reader kwargs, paired permutation, guards, N_TRAIN_LABELS vs preprocessing.luts.n_classes(get_lut('train18')), deform_residual_ranges, data module label files and deform batch size), tests/test_postprocess.py (DeformPostprocess), new tests/test_deform_data.py (phantom, synthetic group alignment and non-trivial initial Dice printed, batch format, DeformValidationSet determinism, loader on a fake export with labels), tests/test_runtime_losses_metrics.py (TestDeformLosses and TestDeformMetrics vs numpy references; perfect alignment loss ~0; gradients through the template).

findings:
VERIFIED (local GTX 1080, uncommitted): `python -m unittest tests.test_data_loading tests.test_postprocess tests.test_deform_data tests.test_runtime_losses_metrics tests.test_diffeo -v` -> Ran 86 tests, OK (skipped=2: the two DALI+GPU pipeline tests, incl. new TestDaliGuard.test_deform_pipeline_aligned_on_synthetic_files). bgr_preproc38: py_compile data_loading/runtime/tests OK, ast feature_version=(3,8) on models/data_loading/runtime/tests (45 files) OK, `import data_loading.params, data_loading.dali_loader` -> DALI_AVAILABLE False. Old tests unchanged (P.linear_ranges('deform', 4) still raises; P.TASKS == ('rigid','affine')). write_fake_export(labels=False) consumes the rng exactly as before.

MEASURED synthetic initial Dice (level 4, n 4, synthetic_deform_group defaults): identity pairwise hard Dice seed 0 mean 0.7742 (min 0.7527, max 0.7939), seed 1 0.7511, seed 2 0.7648; identity template hard Dice (argmax of mean one-hot) seed 0 0.8635, seed 1 0.8512, seed 2 0.8560; max|u| 3.84 vox, RMS |u| ~1.4-1.5 vox.

DEVIATION: synthetic_deform_group default max_vox = 4.0 (plan said 2.0). With 2.0 the identity pairwise Dice was 0.88-0.89 (above the [0.4, 0.85] acceptance range; max 3.0 gave ~0.81-0.83). random_svf keeps max_vox=2.0 default. Implication for FEAT-003 overfit test: initial (identity) eval template Dice is ~0.86, so 'final >= initial + 0.1' means template hard Dice >= ~0.96; if that is too strict, the test may pass a larger max_vox (e.g. 5-6) to synthetic_deform_group or compare pair Dice instead (initial ~0.77) - decide in FEAT-003 (main.py overfit path calls fd.synthetic_deform_group(level, n, seed) with defaults).
